$value = RegRead ( "HKCU\Software\Example" , "Value" )
RegWrite ( "HKCU\Software\Example" , "Value" , "REG_DWORD" , "1" )
RegDelete ( "HKCU\Software\Example" , "Value" )
$encrypted = _StringEncrypt ( 1 , $value , $password , 1 )
$plain = _StringEncrypt ( 0 , $encrypted , $password , 1 )
ShellExecute ( "manual.pdf" )
